options.content: Per exchange+symbol prices/volumes from `mm_market_facts` (best bid/ask, volumes) and `MarketEvent` payloads (book/trade VWAP). Series respect the **Interval ms** filter. Raw ingest health is covered below and in the three Prometheus panels. Use **Price series** / **Volume series** to toggle bid, ask, VWAP, and volume lines.

### Raw feed metrics (ingestor Prometheus, pre-aggregation)

These panels track **raw** orderbook/trade payloads as they arrive at the ingestor (`market:raw:*` topics), **before** interval `MarketEvent` aggregation. Each series is labeled by `exchange`, `symbol`, and `kind` (`orderbook` or `trade`).

| Panel | What it measures | How to read it |
|-------|----------------|----------------|
| **Raw feed freshness ms** | `now − latest_event_timestamp_ms` at scrape time | **Staleness of the last seen upstream timestamp.** Flat and low → feed is updating. **Steadily climbing** while the market is open → no new raw events (stuck poll, dead WS, or ingestor not subscribed). Between REST polls this naturally ramps up until the next snapshot resets it. |
| **Raw receive lag latest ms** | `wall_clock_at_receive − event.timestamp_ms` on the **last** raw event | **Exchange-timestamp vs when we received it.** Captures API latency, network delay, and clock skew. Spikes on each REST poll are normal; a persistently high floor suggests slow venue responses or timestamp drift. Updates only when a new raw event arrives. |
| **Raw event gap latest ms** | `current_event.timestamp_ms − previous_event.timestamp_ms` (per exchange/symbol/kind) | **Spacing between consecutive upstream timestamps.** For REST orderbooks, expect gaps ≈ `poll_interval_ms`. For trades, smaller irregular gaps during active tape; **sudden jumps** can mean missed polls or an API gap. Does not measure wall-clock silence by itself. |

**Healthy patterns:** freshness rises and falls with your poll cadence; receive lag stays within a stable band; orderbook gaps track `poll_interval_ms` from the market-feed config.

**Warning signs:** freshness monotonically increasing for minutes; receive lag far above poll interval + network budget; orderbook gaps many multiples of `poll_interval_ms` without an explanation (outage, rate limit, feed disabled).

panels.title: Raw feed freshness ms
panels.description: Staleness of the latest upstream `timestamp_ms` at scrape time. Rises between polls; climbing without resets means the feed stopped updating.

panels.title: Raw receive lag latest ms
panels.description: Wall-clock lag recorded when the last raw event arrived: `receive_time − event.timestamp_ms`. Reflects API/network latency and clock skew.

panels.title: Raw event gap latest ms
panels.description: Timestamp delta between the last two raw events for the same exchange/symbol/kind. Orderbook gaps should track `poll_interval_ms`.

targets.rawSql:
WITH all_series AS (
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' best_bid') AS metric, best_bid AS value, 'best_bid'::text AS series
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR interval_ms::text = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND best_bid IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' best_ask') AS metric, best_ask AS value, 'best_ask'::text AS series
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR interval_ms::text = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND best_ask IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || COALESCE(symbol, payload->>'symbol') || ' buy_vwap') AS metric, NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(payload->>'book_buy_vwap', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(payload->>'book_buy_vwap', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0) AS value, 'buy_vwap'::text AS series
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND (payload->>'book_buy_vwap') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || COALESCE(symbol, payload->>'symbol') || ' sell_vwap') AS metric, NULLIF(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(payload->>'book_sell_vwap', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(payload->>'book_sell_vwap', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0) AS value, 'sell_vwap'::text AS series
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND (payload->>'book_sell_vwap') IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || COALESCE(symbol, payload->>'symbol') || ' trade_vwap') AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'vwap', '0'), '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'vwap', '0'), ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value, 'trade_vwap'::text AS series
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND NULLIF(payload->>'vwap', '0') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM all_series
WHERE series = ANY(ARRAY[${price_series:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY 1

WITH all_series AS (
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' buy_volume') AS metric, buy_volume AS value, 'buy_volume'::text AS series
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR interval_ms::text = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND buy_volume IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ts AS "time", (exchange || ' ' || symbol || ' sell_volume') AS metric, sell_volume AS value, 'sell_volume'::text AS series
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND (NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '') IS NULL OR '${interval_ms}' IN ('$__all', 'All') OR interval_ms::text = ANY(string_to_array(replace('${interval_ms}', ' ', ''), ',')))
    AND sell_volume IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "time", metric, value
FROM all_series
WHERE series = ANY(ARRAY[${volume_series:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

list.definition:
SELECT run_id
FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT run_id, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id <> ''
    AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY run_id
  ) sources
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(run_id AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY run_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
